tl.d: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.
Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.
Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 10%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 1.0 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 15%.
Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.
Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.
Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 4 sec.
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst by 70%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.
Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 6 yards, and increases the range of your Flame Shock spell by 15 yards.
Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.
Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.
You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 150 to 192 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.
Increases your Intellect by 10%.
Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 20% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 2 sec.
Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.
Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.
Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 40% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 15%.
Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.
Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%.
Increases your Stamina by 10%.
Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.
Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.
When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 100% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.
When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.5 sec.
Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 25%.
Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.
Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 20 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 20%.
Increases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.
Gives you a 70% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.

The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.
Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.
Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.
When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.
Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.
Heals a friendly target for 486 to 534, an additional 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

a.d: Heals a friendly target for 1535 to 1750.
Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 191 to 213 Nature damage.
Imbue the Shaman's weapon, increasing melee attack power by 686 and allowing melee attacks to cause additional threat when using that weapon. Lasts for 60 minutes.

Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 303 to 318 Nature damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.
Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing Physical damage taken by 30. Lasts 5 min.
Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.

The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 178 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.
Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 480 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.
Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 181 Fire damage immediately and 176 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 55 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 40 to 54 Fire damage.
Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the strength of party members within 30 yards by 53. Lasts 5 min.
Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
Instantly inflicts 413 to 459 fire damage to enemies within 10 yd of your active Fire totem.
Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial magic effects.
Cures 1 poison effect on the target.
Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards. Lasts 5 min.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.
Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 284 to 300 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec.
Imbue the Shaman's weapon with frost. Each hit has a chance of causing 203 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 25% for 8 sec. Lasts for 60 minutes.
Turns the Shaman into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 40%. Only useable outdoors.
Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 11 every 2 seconds.
Heals a friendly target for 796 to 886.
Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.
Cures 1 disease on the target.
Summons a Poison Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.
Relocates your active totems to the specified location.
Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 60, if within 30 yards.
Changes the caster's viewpoint to the targeted location. Lasts 1 min. Only useable outdoors.
Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 73 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.
Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 10 mana every 2 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.

Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members within 30 yards: each main hand hit causes additional Fire damage based on weapon speed. Lasts 5 min.
Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.
Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Hearthstone Location.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell cast on a nearby party member to itself every 10 seconds. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.
Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 30 yards by 60.
Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.

Imbue the Shaman's weapon with wind. Each hit has a 20% chance of granting you 2 extra attacks with 433 extra melee attack power. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Windfury Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 120 to 134 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members within 30 yards: each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.
Summons an immobile Sentry Totem with 100 health at your feet for 5 min that allows vision of nearby area and warns of enemies that attack it.
Summons a Windwall Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party members within 30 yards, reducing ranged damage taken by 64. Lasts 5 min.
Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.
Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

Heals the friendly target for 474 to 539, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump is 50% as effective as the previous target. Heals 3 total targets.
Summons a Grace of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the agility of party members within 30 yards by 89. Lasts 5 min.
Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 290 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
Heals a friendly target for 838 to 922, an additional 953 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.
